title: zazz::test configuration
description: Environment variables assert_snapshot reads. zazzled and zazz-worker set them when they run a script's tests; script code never reads them.

entities.title: Snapshot directory
entities.default: tests/snapshots, relative to the test's working directory
entities.details: zazzled points it at the script's tests/snapshots for native test runs (macos/rust/zazzled/src/zazz/native.rs); zazz-worker sets it for WASM test runs (macos/rust/zazz-worker/src/testrun.rs).

entities.title: Update snapshots
entities.summary: When "1", assert_snapshot writes a snapshot that is missing or different instead of failing.
entities.details: Only the exact value 1 turns it on. zazz-worker sets it for a WASM test run when updating is asked for; the snapshot-missing message points at `zazz test DIR --update`.
